json.originalInput: What is SSDI back pay and how does it work in Arkansas?
json.aiOutput: What is SSDI back pay and how does it work in Arkansas? In Arkansas, SSDI back pay is the compensation you are owed for the time between when you applied for Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) and when your application is approved. The average SSDI back pay amount in Arkansas is $12,000 and most cases are resolved within 90 days. Attorney John Williams at Hogan Smith Law has successfully recovered over $2 million in back pay for Arkansas clients. Under Arkansas state law Section 14-7, disability claimants are entitled to expedited processing of back pay claims.
